solution_edges = None
max_iter = 200
for iteration in range(max_iter):
    status = solver.solve()
    if not status:
        print("UNSAT")
        break
    model = solver.get_model()
    # Get true edges
    edges = [var_to_edge[abs(lit)] for lit in model if lit > 0 and abs(lit) in var_to_edge]
    # Build graph
    G = nx.Graph()
    G.add_nodes_from(vertices)
    G.add_edges_from(edges)
    # Check 2-connectivity
    if nx.is_connected(G) and nx.node_connectivity(G) >= 2:
        found = True
        solution_edges = edges
        print(f"Found solution at iteration {iteration}")
        break
    else:
        # Block this assignment: add clause negating the current true free edges
        blocking_clause = [-lit for lit in model if lit > 0 and var_to_edge[abs(lit)] in free_edges]
        if blocking_clause:
            solver.add_clause(blocking_clause)
        else:
            print("No free edges to block, UNSAT")
            break

if found:
    print("Solution edges:", sorted(solution_edges))
    # Verify
    G = nx.Graph()
    G.add_nodes_from(vertices)
    G.add_edges_from(solution_edges)
    print("Is 2-connected?", nx.node_connectivity(G) >= 2)
    # Exact independence number
    max_ind = 0
    for k in range(1, n+1):
        for S in itertools.combinations(vertices, k):
            if all(not G.has_edge(u,v) for u,v in itertools.combinations(S,2)):
                max_ind = k
    print("Exact alpha:", max_ind)
    # Also check min degree
    print("Degrees:", [G.degree(v) for v in vertices])
else:
    print("No solution found")
